jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Prosper AI:

At Prosper AI, we're pioneering the most advanced conversational AI agents tailored for the healthcare industry. Since our founding, we've successfully onboarded dozens of major customers, empowering hospitals and multispecialty clinics to get paid faster and more efficiently, through streamlined revenue cycle management.

Our AI agent, Paige, handles tasks like patient scheduling, eligibility checks, prior authorizations, claim status follow-ups, reducing costs by over 50% for healthcare operations teams. We’re backed by top investors including Y Combinator (Airbnb, Coinbase) and Emergence Capital (Salesforce, Zoom), trusted by innovative healthcare organizations, and are reshaping a $4T industry.

The Role:

We’re looking for a driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help fuel growth across healthcare providers, medical billing companies, and pharmacy hubs. You’ll be on the front lines of our go-to-market motion—identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective customers, and setting up high-quality opportunities for the sales team. You’re proactive, curious about product and AI, and energized by building pipeline in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.

This role is in person in New York City.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect and qualify potential customers through outbound outreach (email, phone, LinkedIn)

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to build and maintain a healthy pipeline

  • Run targeted outbound campaigns in collaboration with Marketing

  • Conduct initial discovery calls to understand customer pain points and assess fit

  • Clearly articulate Prosper’s value proposition and secure next-step meetings

  • Maintain accurate activity and pipeline tracking in CRM tools

  • Share market and customer insights with Sales and Product teams

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–4+ years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role

  • Strong interest in B2B sales, ideally in healthcare, SaaS, or AI

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting and high-volume outreach

  • Organized, resilient, and motivated by clear goals and metrics

  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating cross-functionally

  • Eagerness to learn the product, industry, and sales craft quickly

Why Prosper

  • Early traction with real customers and revenue

  • Huge opportunity in a broken healthcare workflow

  • Competitive base salary + commission + equity

  • Clear growth path into Account Executive or other GTM roles

  • Fast-moving, high-trust team with real ownership

Compensation

  • Base: $60,000 - $70,000 + Equity & Benefits (OTE $104,000 - $125,000)

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI Product Manager - Prosper AI

About Us

Prosper is building the most advanced conversational AI agents for the healthcare industry. Headquartered in New York and with offices in Barcelona, we work with dozens of large and enterprise healthcare organizations. We’ve raised total $35M Series A from top investors like a16z (Github, Slack), Base10 (Figma, Notion), YC (Stripe, Airbnb) and Emergence (Salesforce, Zoom).

Prosper was founded by Josep Marc Mingot (Math+Telco Engineering from UPCTech (Barcelona), MIT Research in Computer Vision, and Product Leader in a NY startup acquired by NYSE:AON) and Xavier de Gracia (ESADE, JP Morgan, Bain & Company, Harvard MBA, and VP at a NY startup acquired by NASDAQ:ANGI). We are a highly motivated team of 20 located in New York and Barcelona, ex-{MIT, HBS, Bain, Math/CS/Physics olympics,...}.

We are looking for ambitious, exceptionally talented team members to help scale our product and support a growing client base. As we prepare for fundraising and rapid expansion in the coming months, we are building a team ready to grow with us.

About the Role

As a AI Product Manager in our Barcelona and/or New York office, your goal is to ensure Prosper’s AI agents succeed across real healthcare workflows of our clients. You will own a portfolio of AI agent deployments across multiple customers and act as the general manager for those agents in production: responsible for design, performance, customer impact, expansion, and the ARR your agents drive.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of product, operations, analytics, and AI. You will go beyond strategy and own execution in detail: understanding workflows deeply, diagnosing issues from data and real interactions, driving improvements with engineering and operations, and building the systems required to scale deployments successfully and owning executive level client relationships including c-suite steerco’s. This role requires wearing multiple hats - combining product thinking, operational ownership, customer leadership, and analytical problem-solving to ensure Prosper’s AI agents succeed.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the center of one of the most important shifts in software: the move from traditional SaaS to AI agents operating real workflows in production. You will help define what great looks like in this new category, while building a strong leadership trajectory in one of the most consequential areas of applied AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of AI agent designs and deployments and their business impact

  • Act as the GM of your accounts, with responsibility for the commercial success of your agents, performance, expansion, and ARR growth across your accounts

  • Define priorities, success metrics, and rollout strategy for each deployment

  • Analyze performance data, identify issues, and drive improvements quickly

  • Work directly with customers to understand workflows, identify new opportunities and solve operational pain points

  • Partner with engineering, product, and operations to ship and scale improvements

  • Build repeatable playbooks and processes across deployments

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Maths, Physics, Economics or a similarly rigorous technical field

  • Strong track record in project management, product deployment, operations, or management consulting, ideally in high-performance environments (eg. high-growth startup, mbb, investment banking)

  • Hands-on experience building/designing software solutions and enough technical depth to work autonomously with engineers, data, and implementation details

  • Outstanding analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, diagnose root causes, and drive practical solutions

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders that includes client’s c-suite.

  • For people managmenet, proven leadership ability, with experience leading projects, mentoring others, or managing high-performing teams

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work alongside an experienced team that has built and scaled a fast-growing, Series A company backed by top Silicon Valley investors

  • Work on innovative products that are transforming US healthcare operations and sit at the heart of conversational agents.

  • Significant growth opportunities as the company scales and the team takes on increasing ownership

  • Competitive compensation

  • Join an international team based in the heart of Barcelona

  • Have real ownership and impact from day one

  • Be part of a culture that rewards bold thinking, analytical rigor, and tangible results

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Prosper AI

Prosper is building the most advanced conversational AI agents for healthcare — human-like phone agents that handle the administrative work draining the system: claims status checks, benefit verification, prior authorizations, patient scheduling, and balance reminders. Our mission is to eliminate $200B in administrative waste so healthcare professionals can focus more on healing and less on paperwork.

Headquartered in New York with an office in Barcelona, we work with dozens of large and enterprise healthcare organizations, and we've raised $35M from top investors including a16z, Base10, YC, and Emergence. We're a highly motivated team of 40 — ex-MIT, HBS, Bain, and Math/CS/Physics olympiad medalists — and as we prepare for our next stage of growth, we're looking for ambitious, exceptionally talented people to help scale our product and grow with us.

What you'll do

At Prosper, we’re pushing the limits of what’s possible with real-time AI. We’re not just making voice agents that “talk”, we’re engineering systems that sound human, reason under strong latency constraints, and adapt instantly to messy, high-stakes healthcare conversations. As a Software Engineer, you’ll be at the center of designing and scaling our platform, the low-latency speech/LLM pipelines, orchestration layers, and reliability systems that make this possible.

This is a full-time role in Barcelona office with the possibility to move to the New York office.

What we're looking for

  • 3-5 years of experience building products end-to-end, from architecting solutions to deploying production-grade software.

  • A strong understanding of the technologies that power our stack or their equivalents in other languages: FastAPI (Python) + PostgreSQL backend with a React (TypeScript) frontend.

  • Experience managing large scale distributed systems with asynchronous workload orchestration.

  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents or other ML models is a plus. We use Pipecat for our voice agents.

  • Founder mindset: ownership + hard work. You see Prosper as a learning step for your future startup.

  • Be ready to handle the challenges of deploying AI voice agents to thousands of daily phone calls.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Maths, Physics or related field (or equivalent experience).

Interviewing Process

  1. Initial conversation to understand who you are, what you want to do, and where you wanna go (30 minutes)

  2. Work on a take-home challenge to discuss in the following interview

  3. Review your solution with a couple of engineers from the team (60 minutes)

  4. Talk with the co-founder (60 minutes)

  5. Offer stage

jobs.title: Founding Recruiter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Prosper AI

Prosper is building the most advanced conversational AI agents for healthcare: human-like phone agents that handle the administrative work draining the system, including claims status checks, benefit verification, prior authorizations, patient scheduling and balance reminders. Our mission is to eliminate $200B in administrative waste so healthcare professionals can focus more on healing and less on paperwork.

 

Headquartered in New York with an office in Barcelona, we work with dozens of large and enterprise healthcare organizations, and we've raised $30M from top investors including a16z, Base10, YC and Emergence. We're a highly motivated team of 70, ex-MIT, HBS, Bain and Math/CS/Physics olympiad medalists. As we prepare for our next stage of growth, we're looking for ambitious, exceptionally talented people to help scale our team and grow with us.

 

The Role

We're scaling our go-to-market team in New York, and the people we hire there decide how fast we grow.

As our Recruiter in New York, you'll own hiring with a focus on sales, customer success and revenue operations, and support other teams as we grow, from the first conversation with the hiring manager to the signed offer.

It's a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll build the pipelines, the interview processes and the relationships with our GTM leaders that let us hire the best people in the market, quickly.

You'll report to our Head of People and work side by side with our founders, our GTM leaders and our Recruiter in Barcelona. This role is in person in our New York City office.

 
 

What You'll Do

  • Run GTM searches end to end: kick-off with the hiring manager, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers and closing

  • Hire across sales, customer success and revenue operations, from SDRs and BDRs to senior account executives

  • Source directly and build pipelines of top performers who aren't looking yet, so most of your hires come from your own outreach

  • Work with GTM leaders to define what each role needs, how we assess it, including role plays and track record, and what a great candidate looks like

  • Close candidates with a clear and honest pitch, including how base, variable and equity work at Prosper

  • Give every candidate a fast and respectful process, working with our Workplace & Culture Manager in New York on scheduling and office visits

  • Keep Ashby up to date and report on pipeline, time to hire and conversion for each search

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, mostly for sales and go-to-market roles at a fast-growing tech startup

  • You've hired account executives and SDRs and can walk us through searches you ran from kick-off to signed offer

  • You know how to assess sales talent: quota attainment, deal sizes, sales cycles and how to check them

  • Strong sourcing: you find top performers who aren't looking and get them interested in talking to us

  • You run several searches at once without dropping anything, and hiring managers and candidates never have to chase you for an update

  • You give hiring managers a clear point of view, backed by data, and push back when a process or a profile isn't working

 

Nice to Have:

 

  • Experience hiring for healthcare, health tech or enterprise SaaS sales teams

  • A network in the New York sales and startup community

  • Experience with Ashby or another modern applicant tracking system

  • Spanish

 

What Success Looks Like

  • GTM leaders see you as a partner in their searches and trust your read on candidates

  • Most of the people you hire came through your own sourcing

  • The people you hire ramp well and hit their targets

  • Candidates rate our process highly, including the ones we didn't hire

  • Time from kick-off to signed offer goes down, and you can show us the data

 

Why Prosper

  • Work on products that are transforming US healthcare operations, at the core of conversational AI

  • Real ownership and impact from day one, alongside a team that has built and scaled a fast-growing Series A company backed by top Silicon Valley investors

  • Significant growth opportunities as the company scales

  • An international team across New York and Barcelona

  • A culture that rewards bold thinking, analytical rigor and tangible results

  • Build the team that takes Prosper to market as we scale in the US

 

Interviewing Process

  1. Initial conversation to understand who you are, what you want to do and where you want to go (30 minutes)

  2. A written exercise at home: how you would run one of our real GTM searches (around 1 hours)

  3. A live session with our Head of People where we go through your exercise and talk about how you work (60 minutes)

  4. Conversation with a co-founder (30 minutes)

  5. Offer stage

 

Prosper AI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Voice AI Workforce for Healthcare

Healthcare runs on phone calls and loses $450B a year to the administration around them. Patients wait on hold, staff spend hours calling insurers, and revenue leaks at every handoff.

At Prosper, we're building the AI workforce that runs healthcare operations end to end. Our voice AI agents answer patient calls, schedule appointments directly in the EHR, verify insurance benefits, automate billing, and get payors on the phone when humans would otherwise wait on hold. We've grown revenue 5x in the last year, partnered with 100+ healthcare organizations covering more than 150,000 providers, and raised $35M, including a $30M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz.

The Role

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to own a named list of the largest provider organizations in the country: national MSOs, PE-backed platform groups, and multi-region specialty organizations.

This is the seat every enterprise seller says they want and rarely gets. The accounts are open, the whitespace is untouched, and the product wins in a bake-off. You're not inheriting a picked-over patch or a pipeline someone else already burned. You're picking the logos, building the plan, and running every cycle from first meeting to signature.

You'll have real air cover behind you. Founder-led sales that shows up on your calls, solutions and implementation teams that make pilots land, a product team that ships what your deals need, and a category with genuine urgency: every provider group in America is being asked what its AI strategy is, and most of them do not have an answer yet.

Revenue is up 5x on a lean team. This segment is our single largest expansion opportunity, and the person in this seat sets the ceiling on how fast we take it.

What You'll Do

  • Own a named account list end to end: account planning, prospecting, discovery, pilot, negotiation, close, and expansion

  • Run long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals across revenue cycle, finance, IT, security, compliance, clinical operations, and procurement, and hold every thread yourself

  • Build durable relationships with the people who decide. The best enterprise sellers are trusted before they're needed. You'll invest in multi-year relationships with CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and VPs of Revenue Cycle, arriving with a point of view on their business rather than a pitch

  • Author the ROI case. Every deal at Prosper is won on a quantified business case: cost-to-collect, denial rate, days in A/R, FTE hours redeployed, cash recovered. You'll build these models from the customer's own data and defend them in front of a CFO

  • Navigate the enterprise gauntlet of RFPs, security reviews, HIPAA and BAA diligence, legal negotiation, and phased multi-site rollouts without losing momentum

  • Convert pilots into platform commitments, designing land-and-expand paths from a single site or specialty to the full organization

  • Direct the resources around your deals: outbound, marketing, solutions engineering, and founders all work against the plan you set for your accounts

  • Codify what works into the battlecards, business-case templates, and qualification criteria the next five reps will run

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of outperformance. You've consistently finished in the top tier of your team, and you can point to the numbers: quota attainment, President's Club, the year you closed the deal nobody thought was closable

  • 6+ years of full-cycle closing experience, with at least 3 in enterprise or strategic accounts and $250K+ ACV deals

  • Command of a real methodology. MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, whichever you run, you qualify hard, you know where every deal stands, and your forecast is accurate

  • Relationship-building as a core competency, not a byproduct. You build trust with senior operators over years, and people who've worked with you once seek you out again. You can win a room of C-suite executives and hold it

  • Entrepreneurial eagerness and drive. You're eager to get scrappy, comfortable with getting in the mud, while at the same time being able to take a 10,000 foot view and have an ongoing strategy that adapts fast to new market signals

  • Comfort with a technical product and the ability to translate AI capability into operational and financial outcomes

Bonus Points

  • Healthcare provider, payer, or RCM selling experience

  • Experience selling AI, automation, or voice technology into regulated industries

  • Fluency with EHR and practice management ecosystems (Epic, athenahealth, ModMed, eClinicalWorks) and clearinghouse/RCM stacks

  • An existing network across provider group leadership or PE-backed provider platforms

  • Early-stage or hypergrowth startup background, especially as an early rep who helped build the motion

Why Prosper

  • A trillion-dollar problem, real customers, and revenue growing 5x

  • Greenfield named accounts with no legacy pipeline and no internal competition for logos

  • Direct access to founders, product, and engineering. Deals get unblocked in hours, not quarters

  • Backed by the best investors in the world. Andreessen Horowitz manages $90B and sits behind OpenAI, Databricks, and Coinbase

jobs.title: Founding Recruiter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Prosper AI

Prosper is building the most advanced conversational AI agents for healthcare, human-like phone agents that handle the administrative work draining the system, including claims status checks, benefit verification, prior authorizations, patient scheduling, and balance reminders. Our mission is to eliminate $200B in administrative waste so healthcare professionals can focus more on healing and less on paperwork.

 

Headquartered in New York with an office in Barcelona, we work with dozens of large and enterprise healthcare organizations and have raised $30M from top investors including a16z, Base10, YC, and Emergence. We're a highly motivated team of 70, including ex-MIT, HBS, Bain, and Math/CS/Physics olympiad medalists. As we prepare for our next stage of growth, we're looking for ambitious, exceptionally talented people to help scale our team and grow with us.

 

The Role

We're experiencing rapid growth in New York and Barcelona, and hiring well is now one of the most important things we do. As our first dedicated Recruiter, you’ll own our searches from the first conversation with the hiring manager through to the signed offer.

 

This is a hands-on role with true ownership. Beyond your own searches, you'll help us build and refine our hiring processes as we scale, from interviews to the data we use for improvement.

 

You’ll report to our Head of People and work closely with hiring managers and founders. This role is based in our Barcelona office, with at least three days a week in person.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Run searches end to end: kick-off with the hiring manager, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and closing

  • Source directly and build strong pipelines of passive candidates; the majority of your hires will come from your outreach

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, assessment strategies, and candidate profiles

  • Ensure every candidate experiences a fast, clear, and respectful process; everyone hears back from us

  • Keep Ashby updated and report on pipeline health, time to hire, and conversions for each search

  • Continuously improve our processes: interview guides, scorecards, outreach templates, and our presence in the Barcelona tech community

 

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally in-house at a fast-growing tech startup

  • Demonstrated experience hiring engineers, with examples of searches you've led from kick-off to signed offer

  • Strong sourcing skills: you excel at finding and attracting passive candidates

  • Able to manage multiple searches simultaneously with excellent follow-through; hiring managers and candidates never chase you for updates

  • Provide hiring managers with a clear, data-backed point of view, and aren’t afraid to challenge ineffective processes or profiles

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken; you’ll work with teams and candidates across Europe and the US

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for AI, healthcare, or SaaS companies

  • Go-to-market hiring (sales, customer success) as well as engineering

  • Experience with Ashby or other modern ATS

  • Spanish proficiency

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Hiring managers view you as a trusted partner and value your candidate assessments

  • The majority of hires come through your proactive sourcing

  • Candidates rate their experience highly, even those not selected

  • Reduced time from kick-off to signed offer, supported by clear data

 

Why Prosper

  • Work on products that transform US healthcare operations, at the forefront of conversational AI

  • Real ownership and impact from day one, alongside a talented and driven team

  • Significant professional growth opportunities as the company scales

  • Join an international team across New York and Barcelona

  • A culture that rewards bold thinking, analytical rigor, and tangible results

  • Shape Prosper’s hiring approach as our first dedicated recruiter

 

Interview Process

  1. Initial conversation to understand your background, goals, and interests (30 minutes)

  2. Written exercise at home on managing one of our real searches (around 2 hours)

  3. Live session with our Head of People and a hiring manager: review your exercise and run a mock kick-off meeting (45 minutes)

  4. Conversation with a co-founder (30 minutes)

  5. Offer stage

 

Prosper AI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

Director of Finance

New York City · On-site

The Voice AI Workforce for Healthcare

Healthcare runs on phone calls and loses $450B a year to the administration around them. Patients wait on hold, staff spend hours calling insurers, and revenue leaks at every handoff.

At Prosper, we're building the AI workforce that runs healthcare operations end to end. Our voice AI agents answer patient calls, schedule appointments directly in the EHR, verify insurance benefits, automate billing, and get payors on the phone when humans would otherwise wait on hold. We've grown revenue 5x in the last year, partnered with 100+ healthcare organizations covering more than 150,000 providers, and raised $35M, including a $30M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz.

The Role

We're hiring a Director of Finance, our first finance hire, to own Prosper's numbers end to end: planning, metrics, reporting, and the finance operations underneath them.

Think of it as building a function rather than filling a seat. You'll own both sides of finance: the strategic side (planning, metrics, reporting) and the operational side (accounting, monthly close, payroll and taxes), run with an outsourced partner you manage.

Prosper is at an inflection point. Revenue is up 5x in the last year, and finance has to scale with it. It's early enough that the finance playbook is yours to write, and consequential enough that writing it well changes the trajectory of the company.

If you've spent years building models and advising on other companies' numbers, this is the version where you own the plan, run the function, and see the business move.

What You'll Do

Own strategic finance

  • Build the operating model from a blank page: annual plan, budget, monthly forecast, and the drivers behind each of them

  • Own the metrics the company runs on: ARR bridge (new logo, expansion, contraction, churn), contracted vs. live ARR, time to go-live, gross margin, burn, and runway

  • Prepare the monthly investor updates

  • Keep gross margin accurate, with COGS and vendor costs, including voice AI infrastructure, categorized right every month

Run finance operations

  • Run a fast, accurate monthly close with an accounting partner you choose and manage

  • Own payroll, taxes, and filings

  • Get invoices out on time and cash collected on schedule

  • Set up spend controls: department budgets, expense policies, and a weekly AP and approval process, so the founders stop approving every expense

What We're Looking For

  • 4-6 years of experience, ideally starting in investment banking and followed by finance at a high-growth startup.

  • Rigor as a core competency. People trust your numbers because they never have to check them twice

  • Builder mentality. You're comfortable being the only finance person at first and getting deep into the details of a close, and just as comfortable stepping back to tell the founders what the numbers mean.

Bonus Points

  • Healthcare or health tech exposure, at a company or covering the sector in banking

  • Hands-on with modern finance tools like Brex, Carta, NetSuite or QuickBooks

  • You've supported a fundraise, a first audit, or a finance system rollout

  • You've managed an outsourced accounting firm and held it to a high bar

Why Prosper

  • A trillion-dollar problem, real customers, and revenue growing 5x

  • A function you own outright: the plan, the metrics, and the team you build

  • Direct access to the founders and the board

  • Competitive base and meaningful equity
